subject: english-literature
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCE A Level English Literature specification (from 2015)

subs: Section A: Poetry pre-1900 — two-part question on one prescribed pre-1900 poetry text (e.g. Chaucer, Donne, Milton, Keats/Blake, Rossetti)
Section B: Poetry post-1900 — question on a prescribed pair of post-1900 poets (e.g. Hardy & T S Eliot; Hughes & Plath; Larkin & Duffy; Heaney & Sheers)
Section A: Shakespeare — two-part question on one play (King Lear; Antony and Cleopatra; Hamlet; Henry IV Part 1; The Tempest)
Section B: Drama — question on a prescribed pair of plays, one pre-1900 and one post-1900 (e.g. Doctor Faustus & Enron; The Duchess of Malfi & A Streetcar Named Desire)
Section A: Unseen prose — one of two questions (period 1880–1910 or 1918–1939)
Section B: Unseen poetry — question on an unseen poem/poetry extract from any period
Comparative study (2500–3500 words) of two prose texts by different authors: one published pre-2000 and one post-2000
Internally assessed, externally moderated; texts approved via the WJEC secure site
